text: [image: Checking Executive Power: Transparency and Accountability illustration] Checking Executive Power: Transparency and Accountability Government power that operates in secret cannot be held accountable. Lydia will restore protections for inspectors general and ethics officials, codify non-defundable oversight offices, and expand whistleblower protections beyond simple firing. Read More

[image: Protecting the Right to Vote illustration] Protecting the Right to Vote Citizenship is already required and enforced to vote. Lydia will oppose new documentation requirements most citizens don't have on hand, restore federal preclearance through the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act, and oppose voter ID rules that turn away legal citizens over a name or gender-marker mismatch. Read More

[image: Supporting Ranked Choice Voting illustration] Supporting Ranked Choice Voting Ranked choice voting lets voters rank candidates instead of picking just one, ending the spoiler effect. Maine and Alaska already use it for federal elections, but Michigan law blocks it even in the five cities that voted for it locally. Lydia opposes any national-level bill to ban ranked choice voting, leaving that choice to states and voters. Read More
